chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: Gigs around Chicago with Tiny Parham, Roy Eldridge and others
summary: He took casual jobs with Tiny Parham, Roy Eldridge, Punch Miller, Minor Hall, Carroll Dickerson and Horace Henderson.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Tiny Parham -- I used to sit in with him. Big guy had a band -- a big fat guy, Tiny Parham. He's an arranger. I used to play gigs with him, you know. Any body had a gig you played that night. Now, I didn't play regular with nobody but anybody had a gig you just play with them, you know. Make a couple of bucks, you know.
I saw in Chilton that during that period you worked with them and they also mentioned Roy Eldridge.

I played with Roy. Not steady, but I played with Roy down there at that -- what club -- it was some club down there in the Loop he was playing. Zooty was playing with Roy then, and so was Scoop Carry on alto.

So, yeah, I fooled around with Roy. And what's his name was with Roy too. What's the bass player around Chicago? I can't think of -- he plays -- played with Lunceford later. What -- I can't think of his name now. But anyway they were with Roy. Zuttty was with Roy too. Yeah, Zuttty was out there with Roy.

I jammed with so many guys around there then, man. A lot of -- there were a lot of good players around Chicago. None of them were really making any money. So, you know, during the summer, why, we just -- anybody had a gig. Say, well, look I got a gig tomorrow night over there. Don't pay a lot but it'd pay about ten, fifteen bucks. I says sure. Well, you know, you have nothing. So, it's a little money. And this is what we did -- all of us played with different guys. I got to play with a lot -- almost every guy around Chicago then -- I at least jammed with them, you know. I played little jobs with them.
Who else? Do you remember anybody else specifically that you (inaudible) worked with in Chicago?
Punch Miller -- I don't know if you ever heard of him. I played Punch -- little jobs with Punch around there. He used to get pretty loaded, Punch did. And Minor
Hall -- used to play a few little gigs. Minor and I played several jobs around. Zinky Coleman, the piano player -- I don't know if you ever heard of him. I played a few jobs with Zinky around there.

But so many. I couldn't even think of all. I played a couple jobs with Carroll Dickerson. Yeah. I played a couple of gigs with Horace Henderson. Horace was around there. Was a nice little -- I just saw Horace too up at -- that little thing going up there at Colorado Springs in the same hotel -- Broadmoor Hotel where we had the thing. He's playing in a dance -- little dance group up there.
Oh, not connected with the Gibson party?
No, but he's in the same hotel --
-- playing in another room. Yeah. Said he's been there 15 months. Yeah. But anyway, I played with a lot of -- awful lot of guys around there then.
